name: Newsroom OS – Editorial Control & AI Assistant
author: koskar22

sections.description:
The Operating System for Modern Publishers

Newsroom OS transforms WordPress into a complete editorial command center.

Instead of juggling SEO plugins, task managers, and AI tools, you get everything in one place — built specifically for news websites and content teams.

🚀 What you can do with Newsroom OS

✔ Assign and track articles across your team
✔ Know instantly if an article is ready to publish
✔ Guide writers with real-time suggestions (no confusion)
✔ Automatically improve SEO and structure
✔ Connect articles into story clusters
✔ Increase pageviews with smart internal linking

🧠 The Decision Engine (Your biggest advantage)

Stop overwhelming writers with checklists.

Newsroom OS analyzes every article in real-time and shows:

  • Publish Confidence Score (0–100%)
  • Next Best Action (what to fix first)
  • Live SEO and structure insights

👉 Writers always know exactly what to do next.

✍️ Built for Editorial Teams

Manage your entire newsroom from one place:

  • Assign stories with deadlines and priority
  • Track active and overdue tasks
  • Monitor competitor content via RSS feeds
  • Detect missing SEO data instantly
  • Identify content gaps

👉 Full editorial control, without external tools.

🧠 Smart Writer Assistant (Inside the Editor)

A powerful sidebar that helps every writer perform better:

  • Headline Score (optimize titles instantly)
  • SEO checks (meta, links, length)
  • Smart tag suggestions
  • Internal link suggestions (1-click insert)
  • Trend Radar (see what people search right now)
  • Quick actions (FAQ, Key Points, Timeline)

🔗 Turn Every Article into a Content Hub

  • Automatic Story Timeline (related articles)
  • Smart internal linking suggestions
  • Better content structure for readers and search engines
  • Increased session time and pageviews

🤖 Built-in AI Tools (No API Required)

  • Generate FAQ sections automatically
  • Extract key takeaways from content
  • Ready-to-use AI prompts for titles and SEO

👉 No extra cost. No external API needed.

⚡ Built for SEO & AI Search (AIO)

Newsroom OS goes beyond traditional SEO plugins.

  • Clean and optimized Article / NewsArticle schema
  • Entity-based content structure
  • Better understanding by Google and AI systems
  • Improved visibility in Search, Discover, and AI results

🛡️ E-E-A-T & Author Authority

  • Advanced author profiles (job title, education, social links)
  • Dynamic expertise mapping (knowsAbout)
  • Stronger trust signals for search engines

⚡ Performance First

  • Lightweight and fast
  • Built for high-traffic news websites
  • Smart caching system (no database bloat)

👥 Who is this for?

  • News websites with multiple authors
  • Editorial teams and publishers
  • Blogs with frequent content publishing
  • Anyone who wants control over content quality and workflow

🧠 Example Workflow

  1. Editor assigns a story with a deadline
  2. Writer opens the editor and sees:
    • what’s trending
    • what to fix next
  3. The system guides improvements in real-time
  4. Internal links and structure are optimized instantly

👉 Faster publishing, better content, full control.

🔥 Why Newsroom OS?

Most plugins focus only on SEO.

Newsroom OS focuses on how content is created, managed, and improved.

It combines:
– Editorial workflow
– SEO optimization
– AI assistance

👉 All inside WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/newsroom-os directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Run the onboarding wizard.
  4. Start assigning tasks and optimizing your content.
sections.changelog:
1.4.1

🚀 The Entity Engine & AIO Update

  • NEW: Deterministic Entity Engine based on Tags (no NLP guessing)
  • NEW: Dynamic Entity Typing (Person, Organization, GovernmentService)
  • NEW: Fully linked Schema Graph with @id nodes
  • NEW: Smart AI Chunking (Summary + Main Content via hasPart)
  • NEW: Auto-Citations from external links (boosts trust signals)
  • NEW: Anti-spam limits for entities, mentions, and keywords
  • NEW: Full AMP schema compatibility
  • NEW: Automatic conflict resolution with Yoast / Rank Math

  • NEW: Author ProfilePage schema for stronger E-E-A-T

  • FIX: Sidebar now displays all active and overdue tasks correctly

  • FIX: Improved cache invalidation (“Smart Nuke” system)
  • FIX: Removed false Paywall signals
  • FIX: Fixed schema date formatting (Google News compliant)
  • FIX: Added fallback images when missing featured image
  • FIX: Enforced HTTPS for all media URLs

1.4.0

  • Added Decision Engine (Publish Score + Next Best Action)
  • Added FAQ & Key Takeaways generation
  • Upgraded dashboard with real-time metrics
  • Improved caching and performance

1.3.1

  • Added Tag Suggestions
  • Improved Internal Linking UI
  • UI refinements

1.2.0

  • Performance improvements
  • Advanced Schema Engine
  • SEO monitoring dashboard
  • Story Timeline improvements

1.1.0

  • Initial release
